policy: Automatic: a choice that cannot change any conclusion is decided by the system and logged.
Agent may apply: such non-flipping choices, when the scientist allows decide-and-tell.
Human only: any choice that can flip a conclusion, at every level, for every actor.
never: For research use only. Not for clinical or diagnostic use.
qPilot never makes a choice that can change a conclusion; those always wait for a person.
